tagline: Leading European media broadcaster with dominant Italian operations
hero_kpi_rationale: Italy revenue represents 73% of total and is the main driver of group revenue, driven by its dominant position in national broadcasting.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the group during the period.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenues for the first 9 months of 2025 amount to 1,939.1 M€, down 3.3% compared to 2,004.7 M€ for the same period in 2024.

kpis.name: Operating Income (EBIT)
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes, measuring operating profitability.
kpis.description: Group EBIT for 9M 2025 is 61.3 M€, down by half compared to 126.6 M€ in 9M 2024, notably due to margin pressure in Spain.

kpis.name: Italy Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by operations in Italy, core of group business.
kpis.description: Italy revenues amount to 1,411.7 M€ in 9M 2025, slightly down compared to 1,431.4 M€ in 9M 2024, representing 73% of total.

kpis.name: Spain Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by operations in Spain.
kpis.description: Spain revenues reach 529.2 M€ in 9M 2025, down 7.8% versus 573.8 M€ in 9M 2024, reflecting stronger advertising pressure.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments, available for dividends or debt reduction.
kpis.description: FCF amounts to 348.9 M€ in 9M 2025, up from 318.8 M€ in 9M 2024, supported by disciplined capital investment.
kpis.signal: Improved cash generation despite revenue decline

kpis.name: Net Financial Position
kpis.explanation: Net cash or net debt of the group.
kpis.description: Net financial position is +2,851.6 M€ at end of September 2025, compared to +718.6 M€ one year earlier, linked to ProSiebenSat1 consolidation and debt management.
kpis.signal: Shift from leveraged to net cash position

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount reaches 12,089 at end of September 2025, compared to 5,178 one year earlier, due to ProSiebenSat1 Media SE integration.

kpis.name: Italy Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by operations in Italy, core of group business.
kpis.description: Italy revenues amount to 1,411.7 M€ in 9M 2025, slightly down compared to 1,431.4 M€ in 9M 2024, representing 73% of total.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount reaches 12,089 at end of September 2025, compared to 5,178 one year earlier, due to ProSiebenSat1 Media SE integration.
